ns2:course.label: Applied Epidemiology
ns2:course.description: (CHLTH 478) Advanced epidemiologic analysis of disease problems. Covers research designs including cohort, case-control, and intervention trials; methods of analysis including multivariate adjustment for confounding and description of effect modification; and application of statistical computer software with emphasis on chronic diseases. Same as VP 520. Prerequisite: CHLH 474, VP 517, or equivalent and advanced course work in statistics through multivariate analysis.
